subject: Business Models
title: Decentralized Autonomous Organizations
description: A 60-second lesson on Decentralized Autonomous Organizations.

hook.text: A DAO is a company with no CEO, no office, and no employees—just code and token holders who vote on decisions.

buildup.text: DAOs use blockchain smart contracts to automate governance. Token holders vote on spending, strategy, and rules.

discovery.text: ConstitutionDAO raised $47 million in a week from 17,000 strangers to buy a copy of the US Constitution.

twist.text: Most DAOs suffer from voter apathy. Less than 10% of token holders actually vote on proposals.

climax.text: DAOs are an experiment in leaderless organizations. The model is promising but governance challenges remain.

punchline.text: No CEO, no office, token-based votes. DAOs reimagine how organizations run.

quiz.question: What is the main governance challenge DAOs face?
options: Voter apathy with less than 10% participation
